cases.reply: Yes — canceling three days ahead is more than 48 hours' notice, so you'd receive a full refund of the amount you paid. Just make sure the cancellation goes through before that 48-hour mark.

Once a refund is approved, it goes back to your original payment method, and card refunds usually appear within 5 to 10 business days depending on your bank. If you paid with Apple Pay or Google Pay, it follows the timeline of the linked card. We're not able to send a refund to a different card or a bank account.

Yes — changes made less than 24 hours before the appointment carry a $25 late change fee, since the professional has already planned their route. If you move it at least 24 hours ahead, rescheduling is free. Keep in mind you can reschedule a booking up to two times.

A deep cleaning is $240 for homes up to 1,500 square feet, so a small apartment would fall under that base price. It includes everything in a standard clean plus inside cabinets, baseboards, the oven, fridge interior, and window sills, with supplies included.

Yes, we serve Denver, Colorado, along with Austin, Dallas, Houston, and San Antonio in Texas. Coverage extends to addresses within 25 miles of downtown, so it's worth entering your ZIP code in the app to confirm before booking.

Yes — plumbers (and electricians) must hold a valid state license, and we verify it before activating them. Every professional also passes identity verification and a criminal background check before their first job, repeated annually, plus a skills assessment and safety training.

You can request account deletion in the app under Account Settings, then Privacy. Any upcoming bookings need to be cancelled first, and your account is deleted within 30 days. We do keep payment and invoice records for seven years, since tax law requires it.

On Sundays, human support agents are available from 9 AM to 5 PM Central Time. Just ask the assistant to connect you with a person during those hours, and an agent usually replies within 15 minutes. If you reach out outside that window, your conversation will be queued and answered first thing the next morning.
We don't handle pest control — it's outside the services we offer, along with roofing, gas line work, and mold remediation. I'm happy to help with anything else you need around the home.
